A juicy, filling snack made by grilling small chunks of meat on a skewer.|Recipe Book|TotK}} also known as {{Term/Store|Zesty Meat Skewer|Zesty Meat Skewers|AoC|plural}},{{Exp Game|AoC}}{{Cite|{{Big|Zesty Meat Skewer}}
A juicy, filling snack made by grilling small chunks of meat on a skewer.|Cooking (Interface)|AoC}} are recurring [[Meal]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}. ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Meat Skewers can be made by [[Cooking]] one to three different pieces of [[Meat]] together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. When eaten, they will restore some of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s to his [[Life Gauge]]. These skewers are juicy and filling snacks that are made with grilled Meat. By adding more ingredients, different variations of Meat Skewers can be made: * '''Chilly Meat Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Meat Skewer}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
A juicy, filling snack made by grilling small chunks of meat on a skewer.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding chilly ingredients. When eaten, Link will gain one level of [[Heat Resistance]]. * '''Electro Meat Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Meat Skewer}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
A juicy, filling snack made by grilling small chunks of meat on a skewer.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding electric ingredients. They grant Link one level of [[Shock Resistance]] if they're consumed. * '''Enduring Meat Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Meat Skewer}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
A juicy, filling snack made by grilling small chunks of meat on a skewer.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding enduring ingredients. These skewers will both refill and overfill Link's [[Stamina Wheel]] when they are eaten. * '''Energizing Meat Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Meat Skewer}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
A juicy, filling snack made by grilling small chunks of meat on a skewer.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding energizing ingredients. If eaten, they'll refill part of Link's Stamina Wheel. * '''Hasty Meat Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Meat Skewer}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
A juicy, filling snack made by grilling small chunks of meat on a skewer.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hasty ingredients. Link gains an increase to his speed when he eats these. * '''Hearty Meat Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Meat Skewer}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
A juicy, filling snack made by grilling small chunks of meat on a skewer.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hearty ingredients. They heal all of Link's Hearts when eaten and will temporarily increase his maximum Hearts. * '''Mighty Meat Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Meat Skewer}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
A juicy, filling snack made by grilling small chunks of meat on a skewer.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding mighty ingredients. If eaten, the power of Link's attacks will be boosted. * '''Sneaky Meat Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Meat Skewer}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
A juicy, filling snack made by grilling small chunks of meat on a skewer.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding sneaky ingredients. Eating these skewers will boost Link's [[Stealth]] for a short period. * '''Spicy Meat Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Meat Skewer}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
A juicy, filling snack made by grilling small chunks of meat on a skewer.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding spicy ingredients. When eaten, they'll grant Link one level of [[Cold Resistance]] temporarily. * '''Tough Meat Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Meat Skewer}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
A juicy, filling snack made by grilling small chunks of meat on a skewer.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding tough ingredients. They'll increase Link's defense when he eats them. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} The recipe for Zesty Meat Skewer is earned by completing the [[Quest]] "[[Cooking for the Common Cold]]". It is made using two [[Spicy Pepper]]s, two [[Raw Meat]]s, and two [[Raw Bird Drumstick]]s. However, it can be lowered to one of each ingredient through the completion of "[[Hungry Hunches]]". When prepared before a [[Challenge]] or [[Scenario]], the [[Warrior]]s will take 50% less damage from [[Ice]]. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Zesty Meat Skewer Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Zesty Meat Skewer icon ==See Also== {{See Also| * Copious Meat Skewers * Food * Meal * Spiced Meat Skewer }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Skewers |items= BotW, TotK }}
